description: This PHP class 'ReportToAccessStrategy' extends 'AccessStrategy' and implementing an access control mechanism based on employee relationships (subordinates and supervisors). It retrieves and processes access data for a given employee number.

classes.name: ReportToAccessStrategy
classes.description: A class that defines access strategy for reports based on employee hierarchy, extending the base AccessStrategy class.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Retrieves access data for a specific employee, including subordinates and supervisors, returning an array of access records.
